ITEM 1 | Flat triangular wedge with golden-brown, blistered crust edges, topped with patchy red tomato-colored sauce and melted pale cheese with light browning spots; crust is firm and dry-looking, roughly 12 cm long by 6 cm wide at the widest point, about 1.2 cm thick, sitting at the left edge of the plate with its tip pointing toward the center | 120

ITEM 2 | Mound of cooked white rice with separated, individual translucent grains and slightly moist sheen; loosely clumped, fluffy and soft with no browning, occupying roughly 12 cm by 10 cm on the right side of the plate and about 3 cm high at its peak, with a few stray grains scattered nearby | 150

ITEM 3 | Scattered small white rice grains lying loose on the plate surface near the rice mound, dry and separate, each only a few millimeters across | 2
